title: fix(app-shell): the list title no longer prints a record count beside the view name
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA6p6wR5XRGmnECFZqr87FM)_

Fixes #34603
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
File surface amended: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`, per L1 REWORK 6938542041 (claim amendment 6938557606).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：控制台列表标题（即视图切换器）不再在视图名后面显示「· 记录数」，桌面和手机都一样；列表底部的「N records」不变。
- **为什么改**：维护者 2026-11-17 原话「列表视图切换的位置也不应该有记录数，这个有点反人类」，撤回 #27594 那一轮有意加的计数。
- **风险与回滚**：只删显示和喂它的那条内部连线（`viewTotal` 状态与列表的 `onTotalChange` 回调），不动元数据、接口和底部计数；回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx`（删掉的计数 span 与 `count` 属性）、`ObjectView.tsx`（删掉的 `viewTotal`）、`ObjectView.titleViewSwitcher-27594.test.tsx`（手机端底部计数的钉子）。
- **两分钟验证**：打开任一对象列表，标题应是「对象 / 视图名 ▾」，后面没有数字；底部仍有「N records」；手机宽度下同样只在底部看到记录数。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The Console list title, which is the view switcher, drew 「VIEW ▾ · COUNT」 (`data-testid="list-view-switcher-count"`). It now draws 「VIEW ▾」 on every width, per the maintainer's ruling quoted on #34603.

- `objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx`: the count span and the `count` prop of `ObjectViewTitleSwitcher` are removed; `useObjectViewTitleSwitcher` no longer takes `viewTotal`.
- `ObjectView.tsx`: the `viewTotal` state and `handleListTotalChange` are removed; `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` no longer passes `onTotalChange` to `ListView` (it fed nothing else). `ListView`'s optional `onTotalChange` itself is untouched; the `list-view` page block's tab badge still uses it.
- Public surface: `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true` and its package entry does not export the switcher, so removing the prop narrows nothing published. The change ships to users through `@object-ui/console`, hence the patch changeset on both (precedent: other app-shell changesets).
- Phone (acceptance 2): measured, not assumed. `ListViewCompactHeader` draws only in the `compact` posture of the `list-view` page block (a page region narrower than half the page), never on the Console object list. The object list's footer `record-count-bar` has no phone-only hiding class, and at 390 px it renders 「1 record」 outside the toolbar's leading slot (new assertions in the 27594 test). So the phone keeps exactly one count, in the footer, away from the view name; no plugin-list change was needed. The card's note that the footer is hidden on a phone did not hold in the source at `97defd60`.
- `ui/e2e/list-toolbar-view-name-phone.spec.ts`: its fixture drops the `· 10` span (it read the count element's classes from the switcher source, which would now throw).
- `ObjectView.titleViewSwitcher-27594.test.tsx` gains the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited test reaching the dynamic import.

- Fix round 1 (L1 6938542041): `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` § Switching views drops the count clause and the `· 12` from the example (now **Leads / My Leads ▾**) and says the record count is in the list's footer. Four stale title comments (`objectViewPageHeader.tsx` ×2, `ObjectView.tsx`, `ObjectView.objectListTitle-27950.test.tsx`) now read 「OBJECT / VIEW ▾」 or 「VIEW ▾」; the 27950 test also gains the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited test. `git grep -nE "▾ · |VIEW ▾ · COUNT|number of records the view holds" ui content skills` (CHANGELOGs aside): 0 hits.

Out of scope, unchanged: the list footer's record count and summaries.
